عَزِيمٌ A vehement running. (K, TA. [In the CK, العَدُوُّ is erroneously put for العَدْوُ.]) Rabeea Ibn-Makroom Ed-Dabbee says, “لَوْلَا أُكَفْكِفُهُ لَكَادَ إِذَا جَرَى
مِنْهُ العَزِيمُ يُدُقُّ فَأْسَ المِسْحَلِ
” [If I did not restrain him, when he runs, his vehement running would almost break the piece of iron that stands up in the mouth from the middle of the bit-mouth: see مِسْحَلٌ]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
